prompt.description: the prompt as it was typed, before the contract; two runs compare only when this text and the contract are both the same

contract.description: the contract as it was typed after the prompt, in the same message; part of what two runs must share to compare

note.description: remarks on the run as a whole, such as the labels step 1 resolved when nobody watched the run

url.description: the conversation's own URL, without its query string; the session id is in it

model_label.description: the model picker's checked entry when the prompt was sent, as the list writes it ("3.1 Pro", not the chip's "Pro")

effort_label.description: the checked effort entry or slider stop label when the prompt was sent, as the picker writes it; none where the site has no effort control

finished_at.description: when the page showed the answer complete; approximate when read off a relative time

read_version.description: the commit, tag, or branch and date the answer says it read, in its words; "not stated" when it names none

polls.description: how many times the session was polled; thirty is the bound

response_path.description: the saved answer, relative to the run folder

status.description: errored is the product's own error message in place of an answer; refused is a decline; not-run is a site the skill did not send to, for the reason in note; smaller-mode is a scored answer from a smaller model or mode than the size asked for, because that one is locked on the account: model_label is what ran, note names the locked one, and the session is left out of any like-for-like comparison

note.description: every remark on the session, in the order they arose, separated by "; "
